title: Serialize the remaining Rust tests that mutate HOME or the process environment
description: Follow-up to kbs-6cd2b1. Several Rust tests (for example in rust/src/gossip.rs) change HOME, the current directory or process environment variables without #[serial], while load_dotenv copies env files into the process environment. They can race each other the same way ai_credentials did. Put every such test under one serial key or refactor it to pass explicit values, and add a check (grep-based tool or test helper) so new env-mutating tests must be serialized.
